text: Jordan spent a productive evening at Groundwork coffee shop working on Coda, a music practice-tracking app, making solid headway on the practice log screen and getting a streak counter with flame animations working, which felt satisfying after months of tinkering. Despite Pepper's guilt-inducing goodbye routine, Jordan resisted the pull to stay home and work from the couch, reaffirming that Groundwork's atmosphere is genuinely better for focus and deciding to make it a regular after-work habit. The evening ended calmly with pasta and quiet time with Pepper, leaving Jordan in a contented, low-key mood, appreciating an uneventful day.
